questions.stem: Among the following options, Tocilizumab is used in which condition?
questions.solutionHtml:
Rheumatoid arthritis
  • Rheumatoid arthritis is a chronic inflammatory disorder that can affect more than just your joints. In some people, the condition can damage a wide variety of body systems, including the skin, eyes, lungs, heart and blood vessels. An autoimmune disorder, rheumatoid arthritis occurs when your immune system.


Lange Katzung's Basic and Clinical Pharmacology- 15th Edition, Chapter 36, Page Number: 20, 33

questions.stem: Which of the following drugs is not used in rheumatoid arthritis?
questions.solutionHtml:
Febuxostat
  • Febuxostat: is a medication used long-term to treat gout due to high uric acid levels. It is generally recommended only for people who cannot take allopurinol. When initially started, medications such as NSAIDs are often recommended
  • FEBUXOSTAT is a xanthine oxidase inhibitor used in gout.
  • Other drugs in the option are used in RA.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 228, 229, 235

questions.stem: Which of the following anti-rheumatic drugs acts by increasing extracellular adenosine?
questions.solutionHtml:
Methotrexate
  • Methotrexate: is a chemotherapy agent and immune-system suppressant. It is used to treat cancer, autoimmune diseases, and ectopic pregnancies. Types of cancers it is used for include breast cancer, leukaemia, lung cancer, lymphoma, and gestational trophoblastic disease.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 228, 921

questions.stem: Among the following options, which drug is a newer monoclonal antibody approved for Rheumatoid Arthritis?
questions.solutionHtml:
Sarilumab
  • Sarilumab: is a human monoclonal antibody medication against the interleukin-6 receptor.
  • Regeneron Pharmaceuticals and Sanofi developed the drug for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis (RA).


Lange Katzung's Basic and Clinical Pharmacology- 15th Edition, chapter 36, Page Number: 16, 33

questions.stem: Among the following, all statements are true about monoclonal antibodies, except?

options.label: D
options.text: Tocilizumab is given IV and subcutaneous

questions.solutionHtml:
Tofacitinib is given IV
  • Tofacitinib is given IV: is used to treat moderate to severe rheumatoid arthritis. It helps decrease pain, tenderness and swelling in the joints by reducing inflammation. It also helps slow the progression of bone and joint damage.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 229
